content.text: What This Actually Is and Why It Matters: Notion templates

Understanding the concept of selling digital products like Notion templates starts with recognizing the need for a reliable and accessible commerce infrastructure. In regions such as Kenya, traditional payment gateways create barriers that limit your ability to reach customers. This situation necessitates a different approach—one that ensures sovereignty over your digital sales. COREMERCH provides a complete solution with tools that are not only free but also allow you to take ownership of your entire sales process. By using our infrastructure, you can deliver your products instantly and securely, ensuring that you retain full control over your transactions and customer data. This framework is not merely a workaround; it is a robust system designed for creators who want to build a sustainable online presence, free from the constraints of existing financial systems.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

The architecture of selling Notion templates through COREMERCH's infrastructure is built on a combination of powerful, free tools that work together seamlessly. Your store is hosted on platforms like GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages, providing reliable access without any hosting fees. Backend operations are handled by Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script, which automate order processing and product delivery. When a customer makes a purchase, NOWPayments processes the payment with minimal fees, ensuring you receive your revenue in cryptocurrency of your choice. All data related to orders is stored in Supabase or Google Sheets, which means you have total ownership and access. This entire setup operates without any reliance on traditional payment processors, giving you the freedom to run your business as you see fit.
Who This Is Built For and Why

COREMERCH is specifically designed for digital creators in regions where payment processors fail to deliver, such as Kenya. This infrastructure caters to individuals selling products like Notion templates, eBooks, courses, and other digital assets. For creators in these areas, it is essential to have a system that allows them to sell directly to their audience without intermediaries that impose barriers. Our solution empowers creators by providing them with an independent platform that not only supports cryptocurrency payments but also ensures they own all aspects of their business. This is about more than just making sales; it’s about establishing a sustainable framework that fosters growth and independence in an environment where conventional solutions fall short.
COREMERCH enables creators to regain control over their digital sales.
The Components That Make It Work Together

The success of your digital sales relies on several key components that form the backbone of the COREMERCH infrastructure. First, you need a hosting solution, which can be easily managed through GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages. Next, backend logic is handled smoothly by employing Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script, which execute order logic and automate delivery. Payment processing is facilitated by NOWPayments, which supports over 300 cryptocurrencies, allowing you to accept payments in various digital currencies. For order management, Supabase or Google Sheets serve as your database, ensuring you keep track of every transaction and customer interaction. By combining these elements, you create a robust, efficient, and user-friendly online store that operates independently of traditional financial systems.
How to Use This Knowledge to Deploy Today

To start selling your Notion templates using this sovereign infrastructure, follow these straightforward steps. Begin by setting up your store using GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages as your hosting service. Next, integrate NOWPayments for crypto payment processing by following the provided guidelines. Load your products, such as your templates, into the system utilizing Supabase or Google Sheets for order management. Make sure to configure the backend logic using Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script for automated delivery. Once everything is set up, test your store to ensure all components are functioning correctly. This process empowers you to launch your digital product business today without relying on outdated payment processors.
